Register a static tool, corrupt its schema object afterwards, and run
ten execute calls past it: all ten must still succeed against the
register-time compile. ajv caches compiled validators by schema object
identity, so a mere rule change cannot expose re-reading - corrupting
the object can, because any execute-time re-compile would throw.
